A '''hyperlane''' connected the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] and [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

==History==
[[File:Ilum-TG.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], end point of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]]]
This [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] was the traditional route to the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It consisted of one uninterrupted [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump directly from [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. This hyperjump could only be accomplished by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and was kept secret by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="NoP" />

This journey was usually made by those who needed to build their first [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], or to replace their lost weapons. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would then travel to the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] of Ilum and look for [[Ilum crystal/Legends|its crystals]], which were used as [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]].<ref name="TEA" />
